captions.detailed: A pair of tactical night-vision binoculars finished in a dark matte olive-green and black color scheme. It features two chunky, parallel cylindrical optical barrels, each equipped with flip-up front lens covers and green-tinted rear eyepiece lenses. A central bridge assembly links the barrels together, holding a small cylindrical focus dial with a red indicator dot on the front and a mounting bracket at the rear.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery script of a night-vision binocular assembly. The model should include two parallel objective barrels with front lens caps, a central connecting bridge, a small front-facing focus wheel, and a mounting bracket at the rear, using dark olive-green and black materials.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed by defining a central bridge part using a series of box and cylinder primitives. Two primary optical barrels are created as symmetrical left and right parts, each utilizing stacked cylinders for the main body and lens caps. A small front cylinder with a red circular face represents the focus dial, while a rear blocky bracket is modeled to complete the mounting interface.
